This tests that hovering over a TEXTAREA resizer turns the mouse cursor into the SouthEastResize cursor.


Inside TEXTAREA: type=IBeam
Over dragger: type=SouthEastResize
Over BODY: type=Hand
Over dragger: type=SouthEastResize
